annotations.title: Place synced scenes in a tab

description: Turns scenes waiting in the game's Inbox (sent by the engine plugin; see game_scenes) into entities in a tab, exactly like dragging them on the site. section auto (default) puts each scene by its project path: ui/ or menus/ to Interface, maps/ or levels/ to Ambience, the rest in Sound effects inside a folder named after the project folder (res://units/x.tscn goes to Units). Or choose the tab (ambience, effects, interface) and, inside it, a folder_id. Without item_ids, every scene in the Inbox. Plugin flow, in order: sync_scenes (the plugin sends its scenes), game_scenes (see what arrived), place_scenes (turn them into entities), mark_installed (the plugin reports the install).

folder_id.description: A folder inside the chosen tab (not with auto). Omitted: the root of the tab.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

item_ids.description: Inbox ids from game_scenes. Omitted: all of them.

section.description: auto (by project path) or the tab: ambience, effects, interface.
